Our Kitchen

Built on fire
and the land’s
best offering

Est. 2019 — Portland, Oregon

Ember & Rye grew out of a simple obsession: what happens when the finest the Pacific Northwest can grow meets an open flame?

Our kitchen has no gas burners. Every plate begins at the hearth — a sprawling wood-fire grill built from reclaimed fire brick, tended through each service by a small brigade who understand that patience and instinct are the only seasonings you can’t source locally.

We change the menu when the farms tell us to. When Thistlebrook’s first Walla Walla onions arrive in June, they take center stage. When Ridgeline’s raw milk hits a new season, we build around it. The fire stays constant; everything else is gloriously impermanent.

Our natural wine list runs deep — low-intervention bottles from small producers across Oregon, the Jura, and the Loire. We pour wines that taste like somewhere, because the food tastes like here.

Executive Chef
Nora Westfield Executive Chef & Co-Owner
The Kitchen

A chef who
listens to the land

Chef Nora Westfield spent a decade cooking in Barcelona and the Basque Country before returning to her home city of Portland with a single conviction: that the Pacific Northwest’s larder was already one of the world’s great kitchens — it just needed fire to unlock it.

“The fire, I always say, is the first cook. We’re just the second. Everything I do in this kitchen is about getting out of the way.”

Before she opens service each evening, Nora walks the hearth alone. She checks the coal bed, adjusts grate heights, tastes whatever is resting. The brigade follows her lead — quietly, precisely, without wasted motion. The result is food that feels effortless and ancient at once.

Our Farm Partners
  • Thistlebrook Farm Willamette Valley — vegetables & heritage grains, year-round
  • Ridgeline Creamery Tillamook, OR — raw milk, cultured butter, seasonal cheeses
  • Painted Hills Natural Beef Wheeler County, OR — grass-finished beef, whole animal program
  • Lost River Orchard Hood River, OR — stone fruit, cider apples, wild sorrel
Private Dining & Events

Gather around the fire

Our private dining room seats up to 24 guests, with an unobstructed view of the open hearth.

Private Dining Room

A firelit room for 12 to 24 guests. Full custom menus, dedicated service, and a wine program curated to the occasion. Available Tuesday through Sunday, with full buyout options on Monday.

Chef’s Table

Four seats at the pass, directly beside the open hearth. An unscripted, twelve-course progression through the evening’s best. Nora cooks, you watch, you eat. Available Friday & Saturday evenings only, $185 per person.

Celebrations & Buyouts

Birthdays, rehearsal dinners, milestone evenings, corporate gatherings. Full restaurant buyouts available on Monday nights, with entirely custom menus, private wine service, and Nora’s full attention.
